definitions.explanation: Money provided by the government, insurance, or other institutions to individuals or organizations, typically as financial support or compensation.

examples.japanese: {給付金|きゅうふきん}を{申請|しんせい}した。
examples.english: I applied for the benefit payment.

examples.japanese: {給付金|きゅうふきん}の{支給|しきゅう}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Distribution of the benefit payments has begun.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{低所得世帯|ていしょとくせたい}に{一人|ひとり}{当|あ}たり{十万円|じゅうまんえん}の{給付金|きゅうふきん}を{支給|しきゅう}すると{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The government announced it would provide 100,000 yen per person in benefits to low-income households.

notes:
A compound of {給付|きゅうふ} (provision/benefit) and {金|きん} (money). Became extremely common in everyday Japanese during and after the COVID-19 pandemic, when the government distributed {特別定額給付金|とくべつていがくきゅうふきん} (special cash payments) to residents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給付金|きゅうふきん}を{申請|しんせい}する: to apply for a benefit payment
- {給付金|きゅうふきん}を{受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive a benefit payment
- {給付金|きゅうふきん}の{支給|しきゅう}: distribution of benefits
- {給付金|きゅうふきん}{詐欺|さぎ}: benefit fraud

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {補助金|ほじょきん}: subsidy — typically for businesses or projects
- {助成金|じょせいきん}: grant — for specific programs or research
- {手当|てあて}: allowance — regular payments like child or housing allowance
